in_sanskrit.name: भोमा

in_marathi.name: Bhoma
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhoma हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Bhoma is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bhuma', which means 'mountain'. In Hindu mythology, Bhoma is the primal deity of the earth, representing strength and stability.

in_bengali.name: Bhoma
in_bengali.long_meaning: Bhoma একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Bhoma is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bhuma', which means 'mountain'. In Hindu mythology, Bhoma is the primal deity of the earth, representing strength and stability.
